summary_zh.motivation: 探明增材制造Ti-6Al-4V中亚表面缺陷与接触应力场对微动疲劳寿命的交互影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过微动疲劳实验与有限元模拟相结合，分析缺陷尺寸与位置对疲劳开裂的影响。
summary_zh.result: 亚表面缺陷显著降低微动疲劳寿命，且缺陷位置相对接触应力梯度决定了裂纹起始位置。
summary_zh.validation: 采用实验微动疲劳数据与模拟结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how subsurface defects interact with contact stress fields to govern the fretting fatigue response of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: A combined experimental and numerical approach using fretting fatigue tests and finite element modeling to examine the role of defect size and location.
summary_en.result: Subsurface defects significantly reduce fretting fatigue life, and the defect location relative to the contact stress gradient dictates crack initiation sites.
summary_en.validation: Validation through comparison of experimental fretting fatigue lifetime data with simulation predictions.
